# P3 — Track B independent run (npac_gyre)

> The ladder's `thin_*` and `superob_*` rows are P0 rows, so this is Track B's P0 run read for the ladder. Its thinning budget, grid, merge radius, noise weighting and modality handling come from the shared `godas_model.build_row` registry — identical by construction, not by independent agreement.

<!-- generated by experiments/47_argo_reports.py -->

> **Track B, written by the same author as Track A.** It re-implements the
> evaluation path — QC re-derived from the raw GDAC files, aggregation by
> pandas groupby rather than `np.bincount`, bootstrap by multinomial weights
> rather than index resampling, distances by the spherical law of cosines
> rather than the haversine — and imports none of Track A's evaluation,
> aggregation or CI code. It can catch implementation error, and demonstrably
> has. It **cannot** establish that a shared conception is correct: if both
> tracks misunderstand the same thing they will agree and both be wrong.

## Cohort re-derived from raw GDAC files

186 profiles independently re-QC'd from 40 raw float files: max |ΔT| = 9.53e-07 °C, max |ΔS| = 1.91e-06 — **ok** (float32 storage precision).

## Independently recomputed calibration metrics (plan P6)

Track A uses a closed-form Gaussian CRPS and scipy's `norm`; this uses a Monte-Carlo CRPS and empirical quantile counts, so agreement is evidence the metric is right rather than that the formula is shared.

| seed | CRPS (MC) TEMP | 90% coverage | PIT dist. from uniform |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1234 | 0.1886 | 0.935 | 0.196 |
| 1235 | 0.1878 | 0.919 | 0.155 |
| 1236 | 0.1824 | 0.959 | 0.181 |
